title: Template
readOnly: Template shared by all editions: the global permission is needed to edit it.
name: Template name
subtitle: Subtitle
subtitleHint: Defaults to the edition dates and place.
gradientHint: Keeps white text readable on a light image (“Text on the image” layout).

scope.label: Scope
scope.hint: A template shared by all editions requires the global permission.

preselectHint: Chosen by default when an email goes to the submitters of the edition's proposals; the author can change it.
imagesHint: Defaults to the edition banner and logo.
imagesUnused: This layout shows no background image; the logo is used by “Institutional + edition logo”.
backgroundUse: shown 600 x 200 at the top of the email
previewHint: The email as the server would send it, on sample text.

notFound.title: Template not found
notFound.description: It was deleted, or it does not belong to an edition you administer.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this template?
deleteConfirm.description: Emails using it keep its layout, without its texts or images.
